name: Sylvir
source:
Strengths - ??? 
Weaknesses - ???

A mysterious woman that lives far out of humanity's reach. She is deeply loyal to Elliot, who she owes her life to.

She dreams of a time when she could be free to feel the wind on her face and the sun on her back, traveling wherever she wished.

She doesn't have much interest in helping Raen, but perhaps with some persuasion from someone special...
